summary: Wharton State Forest tower in Burlington County: a 60-foot tower from 1924, later raised to 100 feet; the register says it is in active service.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register describes a 60-foot tower from 1924 later raised to 100 feet; Wikipedia's table lists 70 feet and 100 feet (30 m); the record's 30.0 m is kept. The date of the raise is not in the sources read.

notes_for_editor: NJ DEP fire-tower pages (dep.nj.gov/parksandforests/wildfire/fire-towers/ and nj.gov/dep/parksandforests/fire/program/detection.html) returned no text from the cache, so they are not cited. A search snippet attributes a 100 ft height and active service to the DEP page; verify before relying on it. Current public access and observer schedule are unconfirmed; the register page is undated. The WHYY text read does not name the tower or give the year. The Batsto Mansion lookout (US 79 / NJ 3, Batsto Mansion House Station) is a separate register entry and is not covered here. The brief's 2004 registration is confirmed.
